scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix api-gateway install && npm --prefix services/auth-service install && npm --prefix services/catalog-service install && npm --prefix services/interaction-service install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.db-push: npx --prefix services/auth-service prisma db push --schema=services/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix services/auth-service prisma generate --schema=services/auth-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix services/interaction-service prisma db push --schema=services/interaction-service/prisma/schema.prisma && npx --prefix services/interaction-service prisma generate --schema=services/interaction-service/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "GATEWAY,AUTH,CATALOG,INTERACT,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold,bgCyan.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgRed.bold" "npm --prefix api-gateway run dev" "npm --prefix services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/catalog-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/interaction-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
